--!strict
-- Country screenshot vocabulary. This module owns presentation, never game state.
local Theme = {}
local Palette = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PetRoll.Shared.UIColors)
Theme.Motion = require(script.Parent.UIMotion).new()
Theme.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Theme.Arcade = {
	blue=Palette.Navigation, gold=Palette.Rewards, purple=Palette.Upgrade,
	red=Palette.Danger, green=Palette.Purchase, border=Palette.Border,
	army=Palette.Army, sell=Palette.Sell,
}
Theme.Colors = {
	ink=Palette.Text, muted=Palette.Muted,
	paper=Palette.Body, white=Palette.Text,
	panel=Palette.Body, line=Palette.Line,
	card=Palette.Card, cardInk=Palette.CardText, cardMuted=Palette.CardMuted, cardMoney=Palette.CardMoney,
	gold=Theme.Arcade.gold, green=Theme.Arcade.green, blue=Theme.Arcade.blue,
	red=Theme.Arcade.red, dark=Palette.Body,
}
Theme.NavigationColors = {
	Cyan=Color3.fromRGB(0,221,255),
	HotPink=Color3.fromRGB(255,0,94),
	Orange=Color3.fromRGB(255,162,0),
}
-- Exact reference swatches shared by the top navigation and its menus.
Theme.PageColors = {
	Base=Theme.NavigationColors.HotPink,
	Army=Theme.NavigationColors.Cyan, Upgrades=Theme.NavigationColors.Orange, Sell=Theme.Arcade.sell, Merge=Theme.Arcade.purple,
	Settings=Theme.Arcade.blue, Test=Theme.Arcade.blue, Odds=Theme.NavigationColors.Orange, Recruits=Theme.NavigationColors.Orange,
	Shop=Theme.Arcade.gold, Index=Theme.Arcade.blue,
}
Theme.HeaderColors = table.clone(Theme.PageColors)
Theme.PageSurfaces = {
	Army=Theme.PageColors.Army:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0),0.55),
	Upgrades=Theme.PageColors.Upgrades:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0),0.55),
}
Theme.PageSurfaces.Odds,Theme.PageSurfaces.Recruits=Theme.PageSurfaces.Upgrades,Theme.PageSurfaces.Upgrades
Theme.ActionColors = {
	navigation=Theme.Arcade.blue, purchase=Theme.Arcade.green, sell=Theme.Arcade.sell,
	danger=Theme.Arcade.red, disabled=Palette.Disabled, selected=Palette.Rewards,
}
-- Opt-in cash affordability feedback for the yard and egg-collection upgrades.
Theme.UnaffordableGradient = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(166,166,166),Color3.fromRGB(92,92,92))
Theme.Assets = {
	Merge = "rbxassetid://122096168414414",
	Cash="rbxassetid://101788696120931", Studs="rbxassetid://93331178043153",
	Rays="rbxassetid://120904904160174", Multiplier="rbxassetid://124712149166140",
	Army="rbxassetid://100291580520125", Luck="rbxassetid://111087925336083",
	ArmyHud="rbxassetid://107457338807219", CallArmy="rbxassetid://125964672530167", MyBase="rbxassetid://76117843071069",
	Shop="rbxassetid://119358432410091", Index="rbxassetid://96489791857751", EggMagnet="rbxassetid://131332157337305",
}
Theme.Rarities = Palette.Rarities
-- Background-free simulator feedback: bold status-colored text and a clear outline.
Theme.NotificationStyles = {
	success={symbol="✓",color=Color3.fromRGB(112,222,98)},
	error={symbol="×",color=Color3.fromRGB(255,120,132)},
	warning={symbol="!",color=Color3.fromRGB(244,194,71)},
	info={symbol="i",color=Theme.Arcade.blue:Lerp(Palette.Text,0.35)},
	pending={symbol="…",color=Palette.Muted},
}

function Theme.SetNotification(label, text, kind)
	local style=Theme.NotificationStyles[kind] or Theme.NotificationStyles.info
	-- Names remain literal; color the full message so status reads at a glance.
	local escaped=text:gsub("&","&"):gsub("<","<"):gsub(">",">")
	label.TextColor3=style.color
	label.Text=style.symbol.."  "..escaped
	label:SetAttribute("PlainText",style.symbol.."  "..text)
end

function Theme.Round(item, radius)
	local corner = item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UICorner") or Instance.new("UICorner")
	-- Shared surfaces are square; intentional circular masks override this.
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0)
	corner.Parent = item
	return corner
end

function Theme.Stroke(item, color, thickness)
	local outline = item:FindFirstChild("UIStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
	outline.Name, outline.Color = "UIStroke", color or Theme.Arcade.border
	outline.Thickness = thickness or 3
	outline.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	outline.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter
	outline.Parent = item
	return outline
end

function Theme.Gradient(item, top, bottom)
	local gradient = item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient") or Instance.new("UIGradient")
	gradient.Color, gradient.Rotation = ColorSequence.new(top, bottom), 90
	gradient.Parent = item
	return gradient
end

function Theme.Frame(parent, name, size, color)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name, frame.Size = name, size
	frame.BackgroundColor3, frame.BorderSizePixel = color or Theme.Colors.paper, 0
	frame.Parent = parent
	Theme.Round(frame)
	return frame
end

-- Structural containers are transparent and fill their parent. They do not own
-- a surface, stroke or animation scale (StarterGui.Example uses the same layers).
function Theme.Container(parent, name)
	local container=Instance.new("Frame")
	container.Name,container.Size=name,UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
	container.BackgroundTransparency,container.BorderSizePixel=1,0
	container.Parent=parent
	return container
end

-- Keep inset-specific overlays inside the one game ScreenGui. GetInsetArea
-- rectangles and AbsolutePosition share the Core UI origin.
function Theme.InsetContainer(parent, name, screenInsets)
	local guiService=game:GetService("GuiService")
	local container=Theme.Container(parent,name)
	local function resize()
		local area=guiService:GetInsetArea(screenInsets)
		local position=area.Min-parent.AbsolutePosition
		local size=area.Max-area.Min
		container.Position,container.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(position.X,position.Y),UDim2.fromOffset(size.X,size.Y)
	end
	local connections={
		parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(resize),
		parent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(resize),
		guiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TopbarInset"):Connect(resize),
	}
	container.Destroying:Once(function()
		for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	end)
	resize()
	return container
end

function Theme.Aspect(item, ratio)
	local constraint=item:FindFirstChild("LayoutAspect")
	if not ratio then if constraint then constraint:Destroy() end;return end
	constraint=constraint or Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
	constraint.Name,constraint.AspectRatio="LayoutAspect",ratio
	constraint.AspectType,constraint.DominantAxis=Enum.AspectType.FitWithinMaxSize,Enum.DominantAxis.Width
	constraint.Parent=item
end

-- Express a designed rectangle in its own parent's coordinate space. Insets and
-- touch targets may remain pixels; artwork/composition must follow the parent.
function Theme.RelativeRect(item,x,y,width,height,parentWidth,parentHeight)
	item.Position=UDim2.fromScale(x/math.max(1,parentWidth),y/math.max(1,parentHeight))
	item.Size=UDim2.fromScale(width/math.max(1,parentWidth),height/math.max(1,parentHeight))
end

function Theme.Image(parent, name, asset, size, position)
	local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	image.Name, image.Image = name, asset
	image.Size, image.Position = size, position or UDim2.new()
	image.BackgroundTransparency, image.ScaleType, image.ZIndex = 1, Enum.ScaleType.Fit, 3
	image.Parent = parent
	return image
end

-- One full-sheet image cropped by a transparent frame; never individual studs.
local studBindings = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})

function Theme.BindStudTexture(pattern: ImageLabel, spacing: number?)
	local parent=pattern.Parent
	if not parent then return end
	local clip
	if parent:IsA("Frame") and parent:GetAttribute("StudSheetClip")==true then
		clip=parent
	else
		clip=Instance.new("Frame")
		clip.Name="StudClip"
		clip:SetAttribute("StudSheetClip",true)
		clip.Size,clip.Position,clip.AnchorPoint=pattern.Size,pattern.Position,pattern.AnchorPoint
		clip.Rotation,clip.LayoutOrder=pattern.Rotation,pattern.LayoutOrder
		clip.BackgroundTransparency,clip.BorderSizePixel,clip.Active=1,0,false
		clip.ClipsDescendants=true
		clip.Parent=parent
		pattern.Parent=clip
	end
	local pixels=spacing or pattern:GetAttribute("StudSpacing") or pattern.TileSize.X.Offset
	pattern:SetAttribute("StudSpacing",if type(pixels)=="number" and pixels>0 then pixels else 28)
	pattern.Image,pattern.ScaleType=Theme.Assets.Studs,Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	pattern.ImageRectOffset,pattern.ImageRectSize=Vector2.zero,Vector2.zero
	pattern.Position,pattern.AnchorPoint,pattern.Rotation=UDim2.new(),Vector2.zero,0
	pattern.BackgroundTransparency,pattern.BorderSizePixel,pattern.Active=1,0,false
	if studBindings[pattern] then return pattern end
	local function resize()
		-- AbsoluteSize includes ancestor UIScales; offset sizes must use local pixels.
		local scale=1
		local ancestor: Instance?=clip
		while ancestor do
			if ancestor:IsA("GuiObject") then
				for _,child in ancestor:GetChildren() do
					if child:IsA("UIScale") then scale*=child.Scale end
				end
			end
			ancestor=ancestor.Parent
		end
		local size=clip.AbsoluteSize/math.max(scale,0.001)
		local relativeWidth=pattern:GetAttribute("StudScaleWidth")
		if type(relativeWidth)=="number" and relativeWidth>0 then
			-- Opt-in for fully scale-authored surfaces; keep the cropped sheet square.
			local side=math.max(size.X*relativeWidth,size.X,size.Y)
			pattern.Size=UDim2.fromScale(side/math.max(size.X,0.001),side/math.max(size.Y,0.001))
			return
		end
		local side=math.max((pattern:GetAttribute("StudSpacing") or 28)*24,size.X,size.Y)
		pattern.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(side,side)
	end
	local function layer()
		clip.ZIndex,clip.Visible=pattern.ZIndex,pattern.Visible
	end
	local connections={
		clip:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(resize),
		pattern.AncestryChanged:Connect(resize),
		pattern:GetAttributeChangedSignal("StudSpacing"):Connect(resize),
		pattern:GetAttributeChangedSignal("StudScaleWidth"):Connect(resize),
		pattern:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ZIndex"):Connect(layer),
		pattern:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(layer),
	}
	studBindings[pattern]=connections
	table.insert(connections,pattern.Destroying:Connect(function()
		for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
		studBindings[pattern]=nil
	end))
	resize()
	layer()
	return pattern
end

-- Connections do not clone with authored SurfaceGuis; bind each live copy.
function Theme.BindStudTextures(root: Instance)
	for _,item in root:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("ImageLabel") and item.Name=="StudTexture" then
			Theme.BindStudTexture(item)
		end
	end
end

function Theme.Studs(parent, opacity, tilePixels, inset)
	for _,name in {"CheckerPattern","PopupStudTexture","FigmaStuds","StudPattern"} do
		local old=parent:FindFirstChild(name)
		if old then old:Destroy() end
	end
	local clip=parent:FindFirstChild("StudClip")
	local existing=(clip and clip:FindFirstChild("StudTexture")) or parent:FindFirstChild("StudTexture")
	if existing and not existing:IsA("ImageLabel") then existing:Destroy();existing=nil end
	local pattern = if existing and existing:IsA("ImageLabel") then existing else Theme.Image(parent,"StudTexture",Theme.Assets.Studs,UDim2.fromScale(1,1))
	local padding,spacing=inset or 5,tilePixels or 28
	Theme.BindStudTexture(pattern,spacing)
	local bounds=pattern.Parent
	bounds.Size,bounds.Position=UDim2.new(1,-padding*2,1,-padding*2),UDim2.fromOffset(padding,padding)
	pattern.ImageTransparency, pattern.ZIndex = 1-(opacity or 0.14), 2
	return pattern
end

function Theme.Surface(item, tint)
	tint = tint or Theme.Colors.panel
	item.BackgroundColor3, item.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.new(1,1,1), 0
	Theme.Gradient(item,tint:Lerp(Palette.Text,0.035),tint)
	Theme.Stroke(item,Theme.Arcade.border,3)
	local inset=item:FindFirstChild("InnerRim") or Theme.Frame(item,"InnerRim",UDim2.new(1,-10,1,-10))
	inset.Position,inset.BackgroundTransparency=UDim2.fromOffset(5,5),1
	Theme.Stroke(inset,Theme.Colors.line,1.5)
	return item
end

function Theme.Label(parent, name, text, size, color)
	local lightSurface = parent:GetAttribute("LightSurface") == true
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name, label.Text = name, text
	label.Size, label.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.new(1,0,0,28), 1
	label.Font, label.TextSize = Theme.Font, size or 20
	label.TextColor3 = color or (if lightSurface then Theme.Colors.cardInk else Theme.Colors.ink)
	label.TextXAlignment, label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	label.TextWrapped, label.TextStrokeTransparency, label.ZIndex = true, 1, 4
	local outline=Instance.new("UIStroke")
	outline.Name,outline.Color,outline.Thickness="TextOutline",Theme.Arcade.border,math.clamp((size or 20)*0.068,1.25,4)
	outline.Enabled = not lightSurface
	outline.Parent=label
	label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextSize"):Connect(function()
		outline.Thickness=label:GetAttribute("OutlineThickness") or math.clamp(label.TextSize*0.068,1.25,4)
	end)
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

function Theme.Notification(parent)
	local group=Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	group.Name,group.Size="Notification",UDim2.fromOffset(720,80)
	group.BackgroundTransparency,group.BorderSizePixel=1,0
	group.Active,group.Visible,group.ZIndex=false,false,20
	group.AnchorPoint,group.Position=Vector2.new(0.5,1),UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.24)
	group.Parent=parent
	local label=Theme.Label(group,"Toast","",34,Theme.Colors.ink)
	label:SetAttribute("OutlineThickness",3)
	label.TextOutline.Thickness=3
	label.Position,label.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,8),UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-16)
	label.RichText,label.TextXAlignment,label.TextYAlignment=true,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	label.Active=false
	return group,label
end

function Theme.Button(parent, name, text, callback, color)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name,button.Text,button.Size=name,text,UDim2.new(1,0,0,46)
	button.BackgroundColor3,button.BackgroundTransparency=color or Theme.ActionColors.navigation,1
	button.TextColor3,button.Font,button.TextSize=Theme.Colors.ink,Theme.Font,23
	button.TextWrapped,button.AutoButtonColor,button.TextTransparency=true,false,1
	button.BorderSizePixel,button.Selectable=0,true
	Theme.Round(button,11)
	-- Layout and hitbox stay fixed while only this visual layer squashes or grows.
	local visual=Theme.Frame(button,"Visual",UDim2.fromScale(1,1))
	visual.AnchorPoint,visual.Position,visual.BackgroundTransparency=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),1
	Theme.Stroke(visual,Theme.Arcade.border,3)
	local lip=Theme.Frame(visual,"LowerLip",UDim2.fromScale(1,1),Theme.Arcade.border)
	lip.ZIndex=1
	local face=Theme.Frame(visual,"Face",UDim2.new(1,0,1,-5),Color3.new(1,1,1))
	face.ZIndex=2
	Theme.Round(face,10)
	local function recolor()
		local tint=button.BackgroundColor3
		Theme.Gradient(face,tint:Lerp(Palette.Text,if tint==Palette.Card then 0.2 else 0.08),tint)
		lip.BackgroundColor3=tint:Lerp(Theme.Arcade.border,0.62)
	end
	recolor()
	button:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3"):Connect(recolor)
	Theme.Studs(face)
	local rim=Theme.Frame(face,"InsetHighlight",UDim2.new(1,-7,1,-7))
	rim.Position,rim.BackgroundTransparency,rim.ZIndex=UDim2.fromOffset(3.5,3.5),1,3
	Theme.Round(rim,7)
	Theme.Stroke(rim,Palette.Text,1.5).Transparency=0.46
	local caption=Theme.Display(visual,"Caption",text,23)
	caption.Position,caption.Size,caption.TextXAlignment=UDim2.fromOffset(6,-2),UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-3),Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	caption.ZIndex=5
	local function syncCaption()
		caption.Text,caption.TextSize,caption.Font=button.Text,button.TextSize,button.Font
		caption.TextColor3=if button.Active then button.TextColor3 else Palette.Muted
		caption.TextXAlignment,caption.TextWrapped=button.TextXAlignment,button.TextWrapped
	end
	syncCaption()
	for _,property in {"Text","TextSize","Font","TextColor3","TextXAlignment","TextWrapped","Active"} do
		button:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(syncCaption)
	end
	Theme.Motion:BindButton(button,visual,face,rim.UIStroke)
	button.Activated:Connect(callback)
	button.Parent=parent
	return button
end

function Theme.Display(parent,name,text,size,color)
	if parent:GetAttribute("LightSurface") then return Theme.Label(parent,name,text,size,color) end
	local label=Theme.Label(parent,name,text,size,color or Theme.Colors.ink)
	label.TextTransparency=1
	label.TextOutline.Enabled=false
	local shadow=Theme.Label(label,"TextShadow",text,size,Theme.Arcade.border)
	local front=Theme.Label(label,"TextFace",text,size,color)
	shadow.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,2)
	shadow.Size,front.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
	local function sync()
		shadow.ZIndex,front.ZIndex=label.ZIndex,label.ZIndex+1
		for _,child in {shadow,front} do
			child.Text,child.Font,child.TextSize=label.Text,label.Font,label.TextSize
			child.TextXAlignment,child.TextYAlignment=label.TextXAlignment,label.TextYAlignment
			child.TextWrapped,child.TextScaled=label.TextWrapped,label.TextScaled
		end
		front.TextColor3=label.TextColor3
	end
	for _,property in {"Text","Font","TextSize","TextColor3","TextXAlignment","TextYAlignment","TextWrapped","TextScaled","ZIndex"} do
		label:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(sync)
	end
	sync()
	return label
end

-- Floating HUD art with a radial backdrop; no card face or decorative rim.
function Theme.IconButton(parent,name,text,asset,callback)
	local button=Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name,button.Text,button.Size=name,text,UDim2.fromOffset(136,132)
	button.BackgroundTransparency,button.BorderSizePixel,button.TextTransparency=1,0,1
	button.AutoButtonColor,button.Selectable=false,true
	button.Font,button.TextSize,button.TextColor3=Theme.Font,31,Theme.Colors.ink
	local visual=Theme.Frame(button,"Visual",UDim2.fromScale(1,1))
	visual.AnchorPoint,visual.Position,visual.BackgroundTransparency=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),1
	local shade=Theme.Frame(visual,"LabelShade",UDim2.fromScale(160/136,160/132))
	shade.AnchorPoint,shade.Position=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.58)
	shade.BackgroundTransparency,shade.ZIndex=1,1
	-- Circular alpha layers fade in every direction, with no rectangular edge.
	-- Compensate for overlap so the center stays at a light 18% opacity.
	local previousOpacity=0
	for layer=1,40 do
		local t=layer/40
		local opacity=0.18*t*t*(3-2*t)
		local diameter=(41-layer)/41
		local disk=Theme.Frame(shade,"Falloff"..layer,UDim2.fromScale(diameter,diameter),Color3.new(0,0,0))
		disk.AnchorPoint,disk.Position=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)
		disk.BackgroundTransparency,disk.ZIndex=1-(opacity-previousOpacity)/(1-previousOpacity),1
		Theme.Round(disk).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0.5,0)
		previousOpacity=opacity
	end
	local icon=Theme.Image(visual,"Icon",asset,UDim2.fromScale(124/136,102/132),UDim2.fromScale(6/136,-2/132))
	local caption=Theme.Label(visual,"Label",text,31)
	caption.Position,caption.Size,caption.TextXAlignment=UDim2.fromScale(0,94/132),UDim2.fromScale(1,36/132),Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	local function sync()
		caption.Text,caption.TextSize=button.Text,button.TextSize
		caption.TextColor3=if button.Active then button.TextColor3 else Palette.Muted
		icon.ImageTransparency=if button.Active then 0 else 0.5
	end
	for _,property in {"Text","TextSize","TextColor3","Active"} do
		button:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(sync)
	end
	sync()
	Theme.Motion:BindButton(button,visual)
	button.Activated:Connect(function() if button.Active then callback() end end)
	button.Parent=parent
	return button
end

function Theme.ActionButton(parent,name,text,callback,color)
	local button=Theme.Button(parent,name,text,callback,color or Theme.Arcade.gold)
	button.TextSize=36
	return button
end

function Theme.PriceButton(parent,name,text,callback,color)
	local button=Theme.ActionButton(parent,name,text,callback,color or Theme.ActionColors.purchase)
	local icon=Theme.Image(button.Visual,"Currency",Theme.Assets.Cash,UDim2.fromOffset(44,42),UDim2.new(0,8,0.5,-23))
	icon.ZIndex=6
	button.Visual.Caption.Position,button.Visual.Caption.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(55,-2),UDim2.new(1,-65,1,-3)
	return button
end

function Theme.SetHeaderColor(header,color)
	local highlight=if color==Palette.Army then color:Lerp(Palette.HeaderHighlight,0.3) else color:Lerp(Palette.Text,0.18)
	Theme.Gradient(header,highlight,color)
end

function Theme.Header(parent,name,title,color)
	local header=Theme.Frame(parent,name,UDim2.new(1,0,0,84),Color3.new(1,1,1))
	Theme.SetHeaderColor(header,color)
	Theme.Stroke(header,Theme.Arcade.border,4)
	Theme.Studs(header,0.14,28,0).ZIndex=header.ZIndex
	local text=Theme.Display(header,"Title",title,50)
	text.Position,text.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(24,0),UDim2.new(1,-132,1,0)
	local icon=Theme.Image(header,"PageIcon",Theme.Assets.Army,UDim2.fromOffset(78,78),UDim2.fromOffset(12,1))
	icon.Visible=false
	return header,text
end

function Theme.Card(parent,name,size,color)
	local card=Theme.Frame(parent,name,size,Color3.new(1,1,1))
	card.BackgroundTransparency=0
	card:SetAttribute("LightSurface",true)
	card.ClipsDescendants=true
	Theme.Gradient(card,Palette.Card:Lerp(Palette.Text,0.2),Palette.Card)
	local rim=Theme.Stroke(card,Color3.new(1,1,1),4)
	Theme.Gradient(rim,color:Lerp(Palette.Text,0.12),color)
	local rays=Theme.Image(card,"IconRays",Theme.Assets.Rays,UDim2.new(1,-12,0,190),UDim2.fromOffset(6,44))
	rays.ImageColor3,rays.ImageTransparency,rays.ZIndex=color,0.76,1
	return card
end

function Theme.CollectionCard(parent,name,callback,rarity,selected)
	local card=Theme.Button(parent,name,"",callback,Palette.Card)
	card.Visual:SetAttribute("LightSurface",true)
	-- Keep the dark outside contour; selection and rarity use the inner rim.
	Theme.Stroke(card.Visual.Face,if selected then Theme.ActionColors.selected else rarity or Palette.Line,if selected then 4 else 2)
	return card
end

function Theme.Number(value)
	value=value or 0
	if value>=1000000 then return string.format("%.1fm",value/1000000) end
	if value>=10000 then return string.format("%.1fk",value/1000) end
	if value==math.floor(value) then return tostring(math.floor(value)) end
	return string.format("%.1f",value)
end

-- Currency has whole coins. Keep exact prices readable instead of abbreviating
-- them to decimals; the floor also hides fractional frames in wallet tweens.
function Theme.Money(value)
	local whole=math.floor(value or 0)
	local digits=string.format("%.0f",math.abs(whole))
	local grouped=(digits:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,",""))
	return (if whole<0 then "-" else "")..grouped
end

function Theme.SegmentedBar(parent,name,size)
	local track=Theme.Frame(parent,name,size,Theme.Arcade.border)
	Theme.Round(track,7);Theme.Stroke(track,Theme.Arcade.border,3)
	local inside=Theme.Frame(track,"Inside",UDim2.new(1,-8,1,-8),Theme.Colors.dark)

function Theme.ApplyPopupStyle(panel)
	if not panel then return end
	local window=panel:FindFirstChild("StandardPage") or panel:FindFirstChild("Window") or panel
	local header=window:FindFirstChild("Header")
	local body=window:FindFirstChild("Main") or window:FindFirstChild("Body")
	if header then

		for _,name in {"Title","PageIcon","Close"} do

			if foreground and foreground:IsA("GuiObject") then
				foreground.ZIndex=math.max(foreground.ZIndex,header.ZIndex+1)
			end
		end

	local function darkSurface(item,isBody)
		item.BackgroundColor3,item.BackgroundTransparency=Color3.new(1,1,1),0
		local gradient=item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient") or Instance.new("UIGradient")
		gradient.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(20,22,24),Color3.fromRGB(3,4,5))
		gradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,if isBody then 0.24 else 0.62),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,if isBody then 0.48 else 0.80),
		})
		gradient.Rotation,gradient.Parent=90,item
		local rim=item:FindFirstChild("InnerRim")
		if rim and rim:IsA("GuiObject") then rim.Visible=false end
		local stroke=item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke")
		if stroke then

			else

			end

	end
	local protected={
		Fill=true,ProgressFill=true,Rarity=true,RarityBadge=true,
		Badge=true,SelectionOutline=true,InnerRim=true,
	}
	local function content(item)
		if item==header or item:GetAttribute("OwnsPopupStyle")==true then return end
		if protected[item.Name] or item:IsA("ViewportFrame") then return end
		-- Action-button visuals and their captions retain their authored colors.
		if item:IsA("GuiButton") and (item:FindFirstChild("Visual") or item.Name=="Buy") then return end
		if item:IsA("Frame") or item:IsA("GuiButton") then
			if item.BackgroundTransparency<1 or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGradient") then
				darkSurface(item,item==body)
			end
		elseif item:IsA("TextLabel") and item.Name~="TextShadow" then
			local _,_,value=item.TextColor3:ToHSV()
			if value<0.7 then
				item.TextColor3=if item.Name=="Title" or item.Name=="Current"
					then Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) else Color3.fromRGB(224,230,233)
			end
		elseif item:IsA("TextBox") then

			item.TextColor3,item.PlaceholderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(245,248,250),Color3.fromRGB(172,185,192)
		elseif item:IsA("ImageLabel") and item.Name=="IconRays" then
			item.ImageTransparency=math.max(item.ImageTransparency,0.9)
		end
		for _,child in item:GetChildren() do content(child) end
	end
	for _,child in panel:GetChildren() do
		if child~=header then content(child) end
	end
end

--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetRoll"):WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Catalog = require(Shared.PetCatalog)
local Rules = require(Shared.Rules)
local ChickenPreview = require(script.Parent.ChickenPreview)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.UITheme)
local AudioController = require(script.Parent.AudioController)
local ActionFeedback = require(script.Parent.ActionFeedback)
local EggController = require(script.Parent.EggController)
local EggFeedback = require(script.Parent.EggFeedback)
local HudController = require(script.Parent.HudController)
local PromptStyleController = require(script.Parent.PromptStyleController)
local ProgressionBrowser = require(script.Parent.ProgressionBrowser)
local UpgradeBoardController = require(script.Parent.UpgradeBoardController)
local EggProcessorController = require(script.Parent.EggProcessorController)
local OfflineCashController = require(script.Parent.OfflineCashController)
local ChickenBrowser = require(script.Parent.ChickenBrowser)
local MergeBrowser = if Config.Features.Merging then require(script.Parent.MergeBrowser) else nil
local ShopBrowser = require(script.Parent.ShopBrowser)
local IndexBrowser = require(script.Parent.IndexBrowser)
local CommerceController = require(script.Parent.CommerceController)
local BaseController = require(script.Parent.BaseController)
local BattleController = require(script.Parent.BattleController)
local DuckAnimator = require(script.Parent.DuckAnimator)
local AppController = {}
AppController.__index = AppController
local C = Theme.Colors
local DESKTOP_POPUP_SIZE = 0.873

function AppController.new()
	local self = setmetatable({connections = {}, requestId = 0, page = "Army", selected = nil,
		confirm = nil, panelKey = "", reducedMotion = false, toastSerial = 0, alive = true,
		recruitIntents = {}, recruitReceipts = {}, productionRequests = {}, productionReceipts = {}, menuBlurOwners = {}}, AppController)
	self.audio = AudioController.new()
	self.feedback = ActionFeedback.new(self)
	self.eggs = EggController.new(self)
	self.commerce = CommerceController.new(self)
	self.progression=ProgressionBrowser.new(self)
	self.upgradeBoard=UpgradeBoardController.new(self)
	self.eggBoard=EggProcessorController.new(self)
	self.offlineCash=OfflineCashController.new(self)
	self.base, self.battle = BaseController.new(self), BattleController.new(self)
	return self
end

function AppController:Request(action, payload)
	if not Config.Features.Merging and (action=="OpenMerge" or action=="Merge" or action=="MergeAll") then return nil end
	self.requestId += 1
	local request = payload or {}
	request.action, request.id = action, self.requestId
	local productionKey=if action=="Income" then "EggValue" elseif action=="BoardUpgrade" then request.upgradeKey else nil
	if productionKey=="EggValue" or productionKey=="EggSpeed" then
		local offer=self.state and self.state.boardUpgrades and self.state.boardUpgrades[productionKey]
		if offer then
			-- Keep the displayed server offer with this request; the reply has no upgrade key.
			self.productionRequests[request.id]={key=productionKey,level=offer.level,currentText=offer.currentText,
				expiresAt=os.clock()+30}
		end
	end
	self.remotes.RequestAction:FireServer(request)
	return self.requestId
end


function AppController:NoticePosition()
	-- Menu feedback sits over the dimmed HUD, away from purchase controls.
	local height=self.gui.AbsoluteSize.Y
	local noticeHeight=self.toastFrame.Size.Y.Scale*height+self.toastFrame.Size.Y.Offset
	local top=math.max(if self.panel.Visible then 82 else height*0.24,noticeHeight+12)
	return UDim2.new(0.5,0,0,top)
end

function AppController:SizeNotice()
	local available=self.gui.AbsoluteSize
	if available.X<=0 or available.Y<=0 then return end
	local width=math.max(48,math.min(720,available.X-24))
	local compact=available.X<700 or available.Y<500
	local outline=if compact then 2.5 else 3
	self.toast:SetAttribute("OutlineThickness",outline)
	self.toast.TextSize=if compact then 28 else 34
	self.toast.TextOutline.Thickness=outline
	local bounds=TextService:GetTextSize(self.toast:GetAttribute("PlainText") or "",self.toast.TextSize,
		self.toast.Font,Vector2.new(width-24,10000))
	-- Wrap naturally instead of shrinking text or clipping two-line receipts.
	self.toastFrame.Size=UDim2.fromScale(width/available.X,math.max(52,bounds.Y+24)/available.Y)
end

function AppController:Notify(text, ok)
	if not text or text == "" then return end
	local kind=if type(ok)=="string" and Theme.NotificationStyles[ok] then ok
		elseif ok==false then "error" elseif ok==true then "success" else "info"
	if kind=="error" then
		self.audio:Play("Error",nil,{voiceKey="ErrorNotification",cooldown=0.25})
	end
	local repeated=self.toastFrame.Visible and self.noticeText==text and self.noticeKind==kind
	self.noticeText,self.noticeKind=text,kind
	self.toastSerial += 1
	local serial = self.toastSerial
	Theme.SetNotification(self.toast,text,kind)
	self:SizeNotice()
	Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,true,self:NoticePosition(),repeated)
	if self.toastDelay then task.cancel(self.toastDelay) end
	local duration=math.clamp(#text/24+1,if kind=="error" or kind=="warning" then 5 else 4,8)
	self.toastDelay=task.delay(duration, function()
		self.toastDelay=nil
		if self.alive and serial == self.toastSerial then Theme.Motion:Toast(self.toastFrame,false) end
	end)
end

function AppController:Pet(id)
	if not self.state or not id then return nil end
	for _, pet in self.state.pets do if pet.id == id then return pet end end
	return nil
end

function AppController:TrackProductionUpgrade(result)
	if result.action~="BoardUpgrade" and result.action~="Income" then return false end
	if self.productionReceipts[result.id] then return true,false end
	local requested=self.productionRequests[result.id]
	if not requested then return false end
	self.productionRequests[result.id]=nil
	if not result.ok then return false end
	self.productionReceipts[result.id]=os.clock()+600
	local offer=self.state.boardUpgrades and self.state.boardUpgrades[requested.key]
	if not offer or offer.level~=requested.level+1 then
		self:Notify(result.message,true)
		return true,true
	end
	local name=if requested.key=="EggSpeed" then "Egg Speed" else "Egg Value"
	local benefit=if requested.key=="EggSpeed" then "Every chicken produces more eggs" else "Same value for every new egg"
	self:Notify(name..": "..requested.currentText.." → "..offer.currentText.."\n"..benefit,true)
	return true,true
end

-- Purchase classification describes selection, not a bird arriving at a battle.
-- Keep that identity independently of any encounter so late replication and a
-- later first deployment cannot drop the acknowledgement or replay an old one.
function AppController:TrackRecruit(result)
	local recruit, id = result.recruit, result.petId
	if type(recruit) ~= "table" or type(id) ~= "string"
		or (recruit.assignment ~= "Added" and recruit.assignment ~= "Replacement" and recruit.assignment ~= "Reserve") then return false end
	if self.recruitReceipts[id] then return true, false end
	local now = os.clock()
	self.recruitReceipts[id] = now + 600
	local pet = self:Pet(id)
	local definition = pet and Catalog[pet.species]
	local name = definition and definition.name or "Chicken"
	local assignment = recruit.assignment
	self.recruitIntents[id] = {petId = id, assignment = assignment, createdAt = now, expiresAt = now + 600,
		pendingBattleId = recruit.pendingBattleId, deferred = recruit.deferredUntilContestEnds == true,
		selectedOnce = assignment ~= "Reserve",
		homeAcknowledged = false, arrivalAcknowledged = false, contributionAcknowledged = false}
	local classification
	if assignment == "Reserve" then
		classification = "Reserve"
	else
		classification = if assignment == "Added" and type(recruit.selectedBefore) == "number" and type(recruit.selectedAfter) == "number"
			then "Squad " .. recruit.selectedBefore .. " → " .. recruit.selectedAfter else assignment
		if recruit.deferredUntilContestEnds then classification ..= " · joins after this contest"
		elseif recruit.pendingBattleId then classification ..= " · marching" end
	end
	-- Per-bird potential, not a promise of net home income or cash paid immediately.
	local identity=name
	if pet and type(pet.eggsPerSecond)=="number" then
		local width=math.max(1,self.toast.AbsoluteSize.X)
		identity=EggFeedback.Fit(pet.eggsPerSecond,name.." · "," eggs/s at home",width,self.toast.TextSize,false,true)
		if EggFeedback.Width(identity,self.toast.TextSize)>width then
			identity=EggFeedback.Fit(pet.eggsPerSecond,name.." · "," eggs/s",width,self.toast.TextSize,false,true)
		end
		-- Preserve identity and assignment if a very narrow viewport cannot fit the optional rate.
		if EggFeedback.Width(identity,self.toast.TextSize)>width then identity=name end
	end
	local text=identity.."\n"..classification
	self:Notify(text, true)
	self.feedback:Action("Buy")
	-- Bound presentation history independently of inventory size.
	local count, oldestId, oldest = 0, nil, math.huge
	for petId, intent in self.recruitIntents do
		count += 1
		if intent.createdAt < oldest then oldestId, oldest = petId, intent.createdAt end
	end
	if count > 24 and oldestId then self.recruitIntents[oldestId] = nil end
	return true, true
end

function AppController:StepRecruitFeedback()
	if not self.state then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	for id, expires in self.recruitReceipts do if now >= expires then self.recruitReceipts[id] = nil end end
	for id, expires in self.productionReceipts do if now >= expires then self.productionReceipts[id] = nil end end
	for id, request in self.productionRequests do if now >= request.expiresAt then self.productionRequests[id] = nil end end
	for id, intent in self.recruitIntents do
		local pet = self:Pet(id)
		if now >= intent.expiresAt or not pet then self.recruitIntents[id] = nil;continue end
		if intent.deferred then
			-- Buy confirms the active lock. BattleChanged uses another stream and
			-- may still cache the same encounter's earlier, unlocked NPC approach.
			-- Release on the state transition (or the actual new unit below), not
			-- that older snapshot. Same-ID holding can still confirm real arrival.
			if self.state.outgoing ~= intent.pendingBattleId or self.state.armyState == "Home" then intent.deferred = false end
		end
		if self:IsSelected(pet) then intent.selectedOnce = true
		elseif intent.selectedOnce then
			-- A better later roll can supersede a recruit before it arrives.
			self.recruitIntents[id] = nil;continue
		end
		if pet.home and not intent.homeAcknowledged and not intent.deferred then
			local model = self.base:HomePet(id)
			if model and model:IsA("Model") and model.PrimaryPart then
				intent.homeAcknowledged = true
				self.base:PulseModel(model, C.gold)
			end
		end
	end
end

function AppController:ObserveRecruitUnit(battle, unit, model)
	local intent = unit.petId and self.recruitIntents[unit.petId]
	local state = self.state
	if not intent or not state or state.outgoing ~= battle.id then return end
	local side = if battle.attacker == state.userId then "A" elseif battle.defender == state.userId then "B" else nil
	if not side or unit.side ~= side or not model or not model.PrimaryPart then return end
	if intent.deferred and battle.rosterLocked then return end
	if battle.phase ~= "Fight" and battle.phase ~= "Capture" and battle.phase ~= "Holding" then return end
	if (unit.hp or 0) <= 0 or unit.reinforcing or unit.retiring then return end
	local pet = self:Pet(unit.petId)
	if not pet or not self:IsSelected(pet) then return end
	intent.selectedOnce = true
	-- Both authoritative coordinates and the displayed rig must be at the site.
	local radius = battle.captureRadius or Config.CaptureRadius
	local position = model.PrimaryPart.Position
	if (unit.x - battle.x)^2 + (unit.z - battle.z)^2 > radius^2
		or (position.X - battle.x)^2 + (position.Z - battle.z)^2 > radius^2 then return end
	if intent.battleId ~= battle.id then
		intent.battleId = battle.id
		intent.pendingBattleId = nil
		intent.deferred = false
	end
	if not intent.arrivalAcknowledged then
		intent.arrivalAcknowledged = true
		self.base:PulseModel(model, C.blue)
		if os.clock() - (self.lastRecruitArrivalNotice or -10) > 1.2 then
			self.lastRecruitArrivalNotice = os.clock()
			self:Notify((Catalog[pet.species] and Catalog[pet.species].name or "Chicken") .. " joined your army", true)
		end
	end
	if not intent.contributionAcknowledged and (unit.impactSerial or 0) > 0 then
		-- This may be the first replicated view after a hit already occurred. A
		-- quiet bird emphasis confirms it; never replay that old hit or sound.
		intent.contributionAcknowledged = true
		self.base:PulseModel(model, C.gold)
		self.recruitIntents[unit.petId] = nil
	end
end

function AppController:SelectPet(id)
	self.selected, self.confirm = id, nil

function AppController:FitPanel()
	if not self.contentLayout or not self.panelMaxHeight then return end
	local available=self.gui.AbsoluteSize
	if available.X<=0 or available.Y<=0 then return end
	-- Leave more world visible around menus; small screens keep their readable reflow.
	local popupSize=if available.X>=900 and available.Y>=550 then DESKTOP_POPUP_SIZE else 1
	local width=math.min(self.panelMaxWidth,available.X*0.94)*popupSize
	local height=math.min(self.panelMaxHeight,available.Y*0.92)*popupSize
	if self.page=="Army" then
		-- Keep the Figma window's proportions so the inspector footer fits on desktop.
		self.armyCompact=available.X<900 or available.Y<550
		if not self.armyCompact then
			local fit=math.min(1.1,(available.X-24)/1474,available.X*0.96/1474,
				(available.Y-24)/976,available.Y*0.94/976)*popupSize
			width,height=1474*fit,976*fit
		end
	elseif self.page=="Shop" then
		width=math.min(1080*popupSize,width)
	elseif self.page=="Upgrades" then
		height=math.min(660*popupSize,height)
	elseif self.page=="Merge" then
		if available.X>=900 and available.Y>=550 then
			local fit=math.min(1.1,available.X*0.94/900,available.Y*0.92/850)*popupSize
			width,height=900*fit,850*fit
		end
	elseif self.page~="Index" then
		width=math.min(760*popupSize,width)
		local motion=math.max(self.panelMotionScale.Scale,0.01)
		local contentHeight=self.contentLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y/motion
		height=math.min(height,math.max(300,math.ceil(contentHeight)+94))
	end
	self.panelWidth,self.panelHeight=width,height
	self.panel.Size=UDim2.fromScale(width/available.X,height/available.Y)
	Theme.Aspect(self.panel,if self.page=="Army" and not self.armyCompact then 1474/976
		elseif self.page=="Merge" and available.X>=900 and available.Y>=550 then 900/850 else nil)
	-- Shared Index/Settings/Odds shell: fixed readable header, flexible scrolling body.
	self.panelHeader.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,60)

function AppController:Counts()
	local state = self.state or {}
	local count = state.count or #(state.pets or {})
	local capacity = state.capacity or Config.StartingSlots
	local selected = state.selectedCount
	if selected == nil then selected = if state.selectedIds then #state.selectedIds else math.min(count, capacity) end
	local deployed = state.deployedCount
	if deployed == nil then
		deployed = if state.deployedIds then #state.deployedIds elseif state.armyState and state.armyState ~= "Home" then state.deployed or 0 else 0
	end
	return count, state.collectionLimit or Config.CollectionLimit, capacity, selected, deployed
end

function AppController:IsSelected(pet)
	if pet.selected ~= nil then return pet.selected == true end
	if self.state.selectedIds then return table.find(self.state.selectedIds, pet.id) ~= nil end
	return pet.slot ~= nil
end

function AppController:IsDeployed(pet)
	if pet.deployed ~= nil then return pet.deployed == true end
	if self.state.deployedIds then return table.find(self.state.deployedIds, pet.id) ~= nil end
	return self.state.armyState ~= "Home" and pet.slot ~= nil
end

function AppController:Groups()
	local groups, byKey = {}, {}
	for _, pet in self.state.pets or {} do
		local key = groupKey(pet)
		local group = byKey[key]
		if not group then
			group = {key = key, species = pet.species, stars = pet.stars, level = pet.level or 1, pets = {}, sellable = {}, ready = 0, deployed = 0, favorites = 0, income = 0}
			byKey[key] = group;table.insert(groups, group)
		end
		table.insert(group.pets, pet)
		if self:IsSelected(pet) then group.ready += 1 end
		if self:IsDeployed(pet) then group.deployed += 1 end
		if pet.canSell == true then table.insert(group.sellable, pet) end
		if pet.favorite then group.favorites += 1;group.favorite = group.favorite or pet end
		group.income += self:PetIncome(pet)
	end
	for _, group in groups do
		table.sort(group.sellable, function(a, b) return a.id < b.id end)
		group.representative = group.sellable[1] or group.favorite or group.pets[1]
		group.protected = #group.pets - #group.sellable
	end
	table.sort(groups, function(a, b)
		local ap, bp = Rules.PetPower(a.species, a.stars, a.level), Rules.PetPower(b.species, b.stars, b.level)
		if ap ~= bp then return ap > bp end
		return a.key < b.key
	end)
	return groups, byKey
end

function AppController:Receive(packet)
	if type(packet) ~= "table" or type(packet.state) ~= "table" then return end
	local old = self.state
	self.state = packet.state
	local state = self.state
	self.eggs:Receive(state.eggs)
	if not old or old.plotIndex ~= state.plotIndex then self.base:RefreshPromptOwnership() end
	if self.selected and not self:Pet(self.selected) then
		local previous
		for _, pet in (old and old.pets) or {} do if pet.id == self.selected then previous = pet;break end end
		self.selected, self.confirm = nil, nil
		if previous then
			local _, byKey = self:Groups()
			local group = byKey[groupKey(previous)]
			if group then self.selected = group.representative.id end
		end
	end
	local result = packet.result
	if result and not self.mergeBrowser and (result.action=="OpenMerge" or result.action=="Merge" or result.action=="MergeAll") then result=nil end
	local shownRecruit, newRecruit = false, false
	local shownProduction,newProduction=false,false
	if result then shownProduction,newProduction=self:TrackProductionUpgrade(result) end
	self.chickenBrowser:Receive(result)
	if self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser:Receive(result) end
	self.commerce:Receive(result)
	self.progression:Receive(result)
	self.upgradeBoard:Receive(result)
	self.eggBoard:Receive(result)
	if result and result.action~="RefreshShop" and result.action~="PreparePurchase" then
		local shownInMerge=result.action=="OpenMerge" or ((result.action=="Merge" or result.action=="MergeAll") and self.page=="Merge" and self.panel.Visible)
  if result.ok and result.action=="Buy" then shownRecruit,newRecruit=self:TrackRecruit(result) end
  if not shownProduction and not (result.ok and (result.action=="Roll" or shownInMerge or shownRecruit)) then self:Notify(result.message,result.ok) end
		if result.ok and result.action == "Buy" and not shownRecruit then self.feedback:Action("Buy");self.base:PetPulse(result.petId, C.gold) end
		if result.ok and (result.action == "Sell" or result.action == "Promote") then self.feedback:Action(result.action) end
		if result.ok and result.action == "OpenMerge" then self:OpenPage("Merge") end
		if result.ok and (result.action == "Merge" or result.action == "MergeAll") then
			self.base:PetPulse(result.petId,C.gold)
		end
		if result.ok and (result.action == "Income" or result.action == "Luck" or result.action == "Expand")
			and (not shownProduction or newProduction) then self.feedback:Action(result.action) end
		if result.ok and result.action == "Attack" then self:ClosePanel() end
	end
	local count, limit, capacity, selectedCount, deployedCount = self:Counts()
	self.hud:Update(state, count, limit, capacity, selectedCount, deployedCount)
	self.base:UpdateObjective()
	self:StepRecruitFeedback()
	if state.banner and state.banner ~= "" and state.banner ~= self.lastBanner then self:Notify(state.banner);self.lastBanner = state.banner end
	if old and state.lastResult ~= old.lastResult and not packet.result then self:Notify(state.lastResult) end
	self:RenderPanel(old == nil)
	self.offlineCash:Receive(state)
	if result and result.ok then
		local changed=if (result.action=="Expand" or result.action=="Income" or result.action=="Luck")
			and (not shownProduction or newProduction) then self.progression.row else nil
		if changed then
			local name=if result.action=="Expand" then "Capacity" else result.action
			local card=changed:FindFirstChild(name)
			if card and card:FindFirstChild("Icon") then Theme.Motion:Pop(card.Icon,1.18) end
		end
		-- Keep reward motion local to the action, not behind notification text.
		if result.action=="Sell" then Theme.Motion:Pop(self.hud.cashIcon,1.14) end
	end
end

function AppController:Start()
	self.remotes = ReplicatedStorage.PetRoll:WaitForChild("Remotes")
	self:BuildUI()
	self.upgradeBoard:Start()
	self.eggBoard:Start()
	self.audio:Start()
	self.feedback:Start()
	self.commerce:Start()
	self.eggs:Start()
	self.animator = DuckAnimator.new()
	self.animator:SetReducedMotion(self.reducedMotion)
	self.prompts=PromptStyleController.new(self)
	self.prompts:Start()
	self.base:Start()
	self.battle:Start(self.remotes:WaitForChild("BattleChanged"))
	table.insert(self.connections, self.remotes:WaitForChild("StateChanged").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(packet) self:Receive(packet) end))
	for _, entry in {{"Army", Enum.KeyCode.B}, {"Upgrades", Enum.KeyCode.U}, {"Settings", Enum.KeyCode.O}, {"Test", Enum.KeyCode.F8}} do
		local page, key = entry[1], entry[2]
		ContextActionService:BindAction("PetRoll" .. page, function(_, inputState)
			if inputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
			if page == "Test" and (not self.state or not self.state.debugAllowed) then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
			self:TogglePage(page)
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
		end, false, key)
	end
	table.insert(self.connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and self.panel.Visible then self:ClosePanel() end
	end))
	self:Request("Sync")
	print("[PetRoll] My Chicken Army! client ready")
end

function AppController:Destroy()
	self.alive = false
	if self.toastDelay then task.cancel(self.toastDelay);self.toastDelay=nil end
	Theme.Motion:Reset()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("PetRollClosePanel")
	for _, connection in self.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	for _, page in {"Army", "Upgrades", "Settings", "Test"} do ContextActionService:UnbindAction("PetRoll" .. page) end
	if self.animator then self.animator:Destroy() end
	if self.prompts then self.prompts:Destroy() end
	self.commerce:Destroy();self.shopBrowser:Destroy();self.indexBrowser:Destroy()
	if self.mergeBrowser then self.mergeBrowser:Destroy() end
	self.progression:Destroy()
	self.upgradeBoard:Destroy()
	self.eggBoard:Destroy()
	self.offlineCash:Destroy()
	if self.menuBlur then self.menuBlur:Destroy();self.menuBlur=nil end
	table.clear(self.menuBlurOwners)
	self.eggs:Destroy();self.base:Destroy();self.battle:Destroy();self.feedback:Destroy();self.audio:Destroy()
	self.recruitIntents,self.recruitReceipts={},{}
	self.productionRequests,self.productionReceipts={},{}
	self.gui:Destroy()
end

	local results=table.pack(renderPanelContent(self,...))
	Theme.ApplyPopupStyle(self.panel)
	return table.unpack(results,1,results.n)
